subject: Reading a big data object into memory as data frame results in 'unused agrument(s)' error

messages.author: c7180a174f4bfe1c
messages.subject: Reading a big data object into memory as data frame results in 'unused agrument(s)' error
parts:
Well, I am sorry this is embarassingly simple and I must be doing something wrong. So I keep getting 'unused argument(s)' error whenever I try to read a big data object (output from a mapreduce job) into memory as a data frame:

> imdf=from.dfs(maxima.bigdata,to.data.frame=T)
Error in from.dfs(maxima.bigdata, to.data.frame = T) :
  unused argument(s) (to.data.frame = T)

So I work around by doing:

> im=from.dfs(maxima.bigdata)
> imdf=data.frame(groupind=im$key,maxfreq=im$val)
> imdf
  groupind maxfreq
1        1     322
2        3     423
3        4    1008
4        5     383
5        6     143
6        8    2654
7        9   32101

Why doesn't my to.data.frame option work? I must have missed an option/parameter in the from.dfs function there, what could it be? I am using version rmr2 2.0.2, R version 2.15.1. Thanks in advance!!!

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#713] Reading a big data object into memory as data frame results in 'unused agrument(s)' error
parts:
Because from.dfs doesn't have that option. help(from.dfs) is the fastest way to find out. It's not recommended to access the internal representation of a keyval pair, please use the accessor function keys and values instead. 


Antonio
